We need to find a template that when applied to the target molecule (the product) gives precursors. The product is the brominated aromatic ring with nitro group and some fused ring system? Actually SMILES: O=[N+]([O-])c1cc(Br)c2c(c1)CCC1(CCC1)O2. That's a brominated aromatic fused with a bicyclic? Anyway we need to search template catalog. The tool expects bonds_formed as "6-6" etc. We can omit bonds criteria. Use functional_groups_formed halide. Also maybe functional_groups_broken? Not needed.

Let's search with functional_groups_formed halide only.
